architecture_scope: Move one actor-local multi-tick safety mechanic into the persistent task layer. Keep the existing arbiter and native terrain-following executor.
gate_state: terminal_capture_published_and_remote_verified; independent_sol_review_no_go; one bounded implementation and compiled recurrence replay admitted

first_broken_edge.cause: Ordinary sub-yard actor or parasite displacement rearms a terminally rejected personal escape as a new generation inside the same semantic hazard wave.

next_action: Implement one actor-local persistent personal-parasite escape task with stable wave identity, measured progress, bounded alternate route, and typed terminal outcomes. Add a compiled production-boundary replay and obtain independent review before any build or live run.

allowed: one small actor-local persistent task type and runner
production wiring through existing Magmaw facts, intents, arbiter, and typed native outcome feedback
one bounded distinct alternate route after terminal rejection
compiled recurrence tests and diagnostics for task progress and terminal state
skill guidance that generalizes task identity, progress, and failure semantics
forbidden: worldserver, authserver, database, or DVC mutation during implementation
bot-side vertical steering or Z correction
route-coordinate, fallback-coordinate, MMAP, floor, endpoint-tolerance, path-admission, or terrain-following changes
priority, class, pet, boss-script, DPS, consumable, or raid-route tuning
unbounded retries or geometry-change-based task rearming

acceptance: small actor and hazard displacement cannot rearm the same wave after terminal rejection
a new stable hazard wave may create one new task
successful movement remains owned until measured safety or arrival
a second bot reacting to the same wave has a distinct actor-local task
ordinary combat recovery resumes after the task reaches a terminal state
all touched C and C++ files remain below 1000 lines
no priority, route, movement admission, MMAP, terrain-following, or Z behavior changes
